name: Code graph
blurb: A repository's definitions and the references between them, resolved by the TypeScript compiler, one graph state per commit, so a pull request's branch diff shows what it changed in the call graph.
about: Build a living code graph of a repository, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps every definition and the references between them, resolved by the TypeScript compiler, so callers, implementations and the impact of a change are exact rather than guessed from names. CI indexes each pull request onto a branch of its own, so the graph follows the code commit by commit. Coding agents read it while they work and post what a change does to the call graph, and a person merges each branch.
sample: hono's router, before and after a real pull request
